hermes-tombstone-incident.fact: hermes-agent #67781 (OPEN P2, 2026-07-18/20): stale-route recovery RESURRECTED a daily-reset-finaled session because durable end_reason promotion failed inside a swallowed try/except while the in-memory flag succeeded -> 23h extra runtime, ~$12.10, 206 calls. Lesson: recovery must REFUSE when ANY terminal marker is present/incomplete (tombstone atomicity). Related trail: #45966 cache split-brain, #57836 stale OAuth blocks startup, #35838 stale-while-revalidate proposal.
